Q: Filter/Extract a text from excel sheet having similar values A:

With REGEXTEST function you can use this formula:

=REGEXTEST(A1,"Maria(?=[^\w])")

These are the results with the test data

Input Result

FALSE
[Maria] TRUE
[AnythinMariag] FALSE
[Marian,Amber,Maria] TRUE
FALSE
[Maria,Marian] TRUE

Q: Renaming IDEA multi-module project directory A:

  1. Rename your project / directory.

  2. Close the project.

  3. Remove the .idea folder from the project.

  4. Reopen the project.

Q: Azure Active directory Add Assignment button greyed out A:

If you use PIM (Privileged Identity Management) then you can check if you can assign permissions there (you must be a member of the Privileged Role Administrator role).

https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active-directory/privileged-identity-management/pim-how-to-add-role-to-user

Q: postgres / docker: password authentication failed for user A:

Turns out this was more of a individual basis error. The docker-compose.yml which was created and until now only used on linux os contained the following:

  PGDATA: /var/lib/postgresql/pgdata # needed as we're using the data folder as mount point
volumes:
  - ./docker/db:/var/lib/postgresql

paths which don't exist on a macos.
